name: date-validator
description: Date string validation, range checking, leap year detection, and weekday/weekend classification.
aiPromptContext: Use this block to validate date strings in forms or data pipelines, check if dates fall in a valid range, determine leap years, and classify dates as weekdays or weekends. Supports ISO 8601 and common date format patterns.

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: The date string to validate (e.g. '2024-01-15' or '15/01/2024').
